# 瑜伽論劫章頌

**ID:** X0794

**Byline:** 唐 窺基撰
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 618–907
**Juans:** 1

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle versified summary by [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) (632–682) of the cosmological *kalpa* (劫) sections of the *Yúqié shī dì lùn* ([KR6n0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0001), T30n1579) — specifically the discussions of the eras of cosmic dissolution and reconstitution scattered through the *Běndì fēn* 本地分. The text condenses the relevant prose of the master treatise into mnemonic verse for memorisation by Cí'ēnzōng / Fǎxiàng students. Preserved only in the *Xuzangjing* (X47n0794).

**Abstract**

The *jiézhāng* 劫章 ("kalpa sections") are the cosmological background to the path-discussions of the *Yogācārabhūmi*: the treatise's accounts of the *Saṃvarta-* and *Vivarta-kalpas*, of the levels of the desire-form-formless realms, and of the bodhisattva-careers extended over multiple aeons. Kuījī condensed this cosmological apparatus into versified form for ease of memorisation, complementing his much longer prose commentaries [KR6n0008](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0008) *Yúqié shī dì lùn lüèzuǎn* and the lost *Yúqié shī dì lùn shū*. The text is one of his three principal works on the *Yogācārabhūmi*.

The composition window adopted (660–682) covers Kuījī's mature teaching period at the Dà Cí'ēnsì 大慈恩寺 in Cháng'ān. The text was transmitted to Sillan Korea and to Heian Japan, where it became a standard introductory verse-text for *Hossō* novices and is referenced in early Japanese Hossō works such as Zenju 善珠's *Yuga-ron-jichō-ke* 瑜伽論時頌科 (now lost).
